root_cause: ActivateBuilding calls SetSimulatePhysics(true) BEFORE RegisterComponent. Exact UE5.8 UGeometryCollectionComponent::SetSimulatePhysics (cpp:1323) first EnsurePhysicsStateCreated -> RecreatePhysicsState, which refuses creation while unregistered (ActorComponent.cpp:2594). It then falls back directly to RegisterAndInitializePhysicsProxy, BYPASSING OnCreatePhysicsState. Registration later sees an existing proxy and skips the entire guarded initialization: physics user data, per-leaf DynamicState/Active initialization, anchored attribute copy and BuildInitialFilterData (GeometryCollectionComponent.cpp:3844-3932). This explains both no world collision ray and no fragment movement despite a valid proxy.
implemented_fix: ActivateBuilding now uses RegisterRuntimePhysics: RegisterComponent first, then SetSimulatePhysics. A proxy already created while unregistered is rejected, never treated as readiness.

Before stripping intact geometry, ValidateCollisionData checks complete unique leaf mapping, a clustered root implicit, every leaf's cooked SimulatableParticles flag, non-null positive-size finite implicit bounds, positive finite mass and finite mass-to-local transform. Validate SimulatableParticles, NOT Active, for clustered leaves: UE5.8 proxy initialization intentionally disables children while enabling the root.
